summary: BA Credit Card Funding, LLC filed an 8-K reporting the issuance by BA Credit Card Trust of its BAseries Class A(2026-1) Notes on May 14, 2026. This is a routine ABS shelf takedown in the ordinary course of the issuer's asset-backed securitization program. No sale of the company, merger, tender offer, activist campaign, or other special situation is disclosed. The filing includes a legality opinion from Richards, Layton & Finger, P.A. There are no deal terms, premium, or unusual structural features. This is purely a financing event with no change-of-control or strategic implications.
